name: chalkboard
title: Chalkboard
description: A bar or café chalkboard in a mitred wooden frame, with a ledge, chalk and an eraser: headings, notices, lists and menus with prices on dot leaders, hand-written in grainy chalk on slate or green board. The words stay real, selectable text. It can write itself in line by line with a clip reveal, and new content makes the eraser wipe the old words and leave a smudge first. A region named by its label, with write for agents. Caveat from npm (OFL-1.1).

docs: `<Chalkboard label content|defaultContent onContentChange reveal writingSpeed surface tray>`. Content is blocks (`{ type: "heading" | "text", text }`, `{ type: "list", items }`, `{ type: "menu", items: [{ name, price, note }] }`, each with an optional chalk `color`: `white`, `yellow`, `pink`, `blue`, `green`) or plain text, a line each: `# Today` a heading, `- Soup` a list item, `Coffee ... 2.50` or `Coffee | 2.50` a menu line, anything else text. `reveal` writes each line left to right (right to left in RTL) at `writingSpeed` characters per second, after the one before; reduced motion shows it at once and fades a change. An agent's `write(content)` takes the same text or blocks and fails with why for anything else. The frame, slate, chalk texture and smudge are the item's `css`, which also imports `@fontsource-variable/caveat`.
